title: Central and Peripheral Nervous Systems
summary: Vertebrate nervous system composition; CNS and PNS; cranial nerves; spinal nerves; autonomic nervous system.
objectives: State the number of cranial and spinal nerve pairs.
revision: CNS = brain + spinal cord. PNS = all other nerves. 12 cranial, 31 spinal pairs. Sympathetic = fight/flight; Parasympathetic = rest/digest.
confusions: Mixing up sympathetic and parasympathetic effects.

notes.t: The brain and spinal cord — the control centre of the nervous system.
All nerves outside the brain and spinal cord — connects CNS to limbs and organs.

r: Emerge from the brain; serve head and neck.
Emerge from the spinal cord; serve body.

notes.t: CNS = brain + spinal cord; PNS = nerves outside CNS. 12 cranial nerves and 31 spinal nerve pairs are frequently tested facts.

mnemonics.title: CPSA
mnemonics.text: C — CNS (brain + spinal cord), P — PNS (nerves outside CNS), S — Sympathetic (fight or flight), A — Autonomic (both divisions)
